title: Feel the casino atmosphere — without real money.
subtitle: Zamrud Play is a simulation playground: spin slots, place roulette bets, outsmart blackjack and guess the dice with free virtual coins. Every result is computed by the server under open rules.
coinsBody: Every player gets free virtual coins. Coins cannot be bought, withdrawn, sent to other players, or exchanged for anything of monetary value.

coins_free.title: Always free
coins_free.text: Starting balance, daily rewards and mission rewards cost nothing.

coins_noMoney.title: No real money
coins_noMoney.text: No deposits, withdrawals, payments or crypto.

coins_noTransfer.title: Cannot be moved
coins_noTransfer.text: Coins are tied to your account and cannot be traded.

coins_noPressure.title: No pressure
coins_noPressure.text: No fake countdowns, play-more bonuses or loss-chasing nudges.

progressBody: Complete relaxed missions, collect XP, level up and unlock badges. Nothing requires long play or higher stakes.
missionDemoText: Play three different game types within a week.
statsBody: See a summary of rounds, favourite categories and session-length trends. Neutral wording: we show virtual balance change, not income.
rpTitle: Healthy play is part of the design
rpBody: Session reminders, daily time limits, voluntary breaks and cooldowns are available to everyone — and never weakened by personalisation.
